column1: # Amendments to the frozen identity rows after the raw baseline (61b2a261), one per changed row.
# `-` is the row as the baseline projects it, `+` the row now frozen, `#` why. check_identity_rows.sh
# requires the raw baseline's projection, with exactly these replacements, to equal the frozen rows —
# so every post-baseline change is explained here, and an unexplained one still fails.
# 2026-10-17, bug 079: proof_pressure's check_nonce named `#[spec(check_nonce.spec)]`, which is no
# specification; it was "drift-checked" only because its source name keyed the removed name table. The
# attribute now names the specification its theorem evaluates, which moves its subject digest.
# `A` = a row ADDED after the baseline: a subject the baseline never had, so nothing migrated. It must
# be absent from the baseline projection; the frozen rows include it, sorted.
# 2026-10-19, bug 079 follow-ups (Codex land1 review): three negative subject-binding fixtures whose
# theorem mentions `add`'s specification only in a hypothesis (top-level, nested implication, irrelevant
# disjunction). Each carries a stored link so the claim exists to be refused; none binds.
# 2026-10-19, Codex land1 confirmation review: the spec inside an arbitrary function's proof argument.
# 2026-10-19, Codex land1 confirmation review: the spec nested inside the term eval runs.
